summary: Basilisks are fought with melee using crush weapons, and a mirror shield or V's shield must be equipped or their gaze deals immense damage and drains stats. Ordinary basilisks in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon only use a weak melee attack and can be safespotted, but their thin drop table and high Defence make them slow. After The Fremennik Exiles most players kill Basilisk Knights in Jormungand's Prison for the basilisk jaw; knights use melee and magic and can be safespotted from melee, praying against whichever style is reaching you. Cannons cannot be placed anywhere with basilisks.
styleNotes: Weak to crush attacks (zombie axe, dragon mace) with high Defence; Basilisk Knights are immune to cannon and thralls, and no cannon can be placed near any basilisk.
usefulItems: Staff of fire or fire runes with nature runes for High Level Alchemy
Helm of Neitiznot (to combine with a basilisk jaw)

summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna at 5 combat. Regular bats and giant bats are the usual targets because they die to any style and drop only bat bones, so there is no reason to seek higher-level variants. Silvarea (13 bats on the path to Paterdomus) and the Haunted Woods (13, not cannonable) are the largest surface clusters, Abandoned Mine level 1 holds 16, and the Coal Trucks or Taverley Dungeon giant bats are easy alternatives. Giant bats are aggressive to players of combat level 54 or lower.
styleNotes: No weaknesses or immunities are stated; bats are weak melee attackers that hit at most 1-3.

summary: Black demons are killed either by safespotting with Ranged or Magic or by meleeing with Protect from Melee; demonbane weapons and water spells are strong against them. The two best spots are Taverley Dungeon, which packs 24 demons together, and the bottom level of the Chasm of Fire, which has more safespots; both are single-way but cannonable. Their drop table is nearly empty, so lower-levelled players who must safespot often skip the task. Demonic gorillas can be substituted (except on Krystilia or Konar tasks) and are profitable but slower.
styleNotes: Weak to demonbane weapons and to water spells (40% elemental weakness); demonic gorillas are immune to cannon damage.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon (Taverley Dungeon or Chasm of Fire)
Demonbane weapon (arclight, emberlight)
Dusty key (Taverley Dungeon, if under 70 Agility)

summary: Adult black dragons use accurate melee and short-range dragonfire, so use Protect from Melee with an anti-dragon shield and antifire potion. The fastest task is AFKing the five baby black dragons in the task-only upper level of Taverley Dungeon, which need no dragonfire protection; for profit, kill brutal black dragons in the Catacombs (77 Slayer) with Protect from Magic and a crossbow from range, or with a dragon hunter lance. The Evil Chicken's Lair and the Corsair Cove Dungeon are the adult spots closest to a bank.
styleNotes: Dragons are susceptible to dragonbane weapons (dragon hunter lance and crossbow); adults need dragonfire protection while baby dragons do not breathe fire; brutal black dragons add a magic attack and long-range dragonfire.
requiredItems: Anti-dragon shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield (except for baby dragons)
usefulItems: Dragon hunter lance or dragon hunter crossbow
Dusty key (Taverley Dungeon, if under 70 Agility)
Raw chicken and rope (Evil Chicken's Lair)
Mythical cape (Corsair Cove Dungeon banking)
alternatives: King Black Dragon (not for Krystilia tasks)

summary: Bloodvelds have high Hitpoints and low Defence and attack with magic-based melee, so wear armour with good magic defence such as dragonhide and pray Protect from Melee if using prayer. The Meiyerditch Laboratories are the best spot because they are multicombat and cannonable with a cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds, giving the most experience per hour; the Stronghold Slayer Cave is the common choice for its bank proximity and cannon use. The God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon locations are recommended to skip.
styleNotes: Demons, so demonbane weapons apply; they attack with magic-based melee that rolls against magic defence, and Protect from Melee nullifies it.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon
Dragonhide or blood moon armour for magic defence
Ash sanctifier
Goading potion (Catacombs clusters)
Nature runes for alchemy

summary: Blue dragons use melee and short-range dragonfire, so bring an anti-dragon shield or antifire and pray Protect from Melee, or safespot them with Ranged, Magic or a halberd since they are large. For a fast task, take a dwarf multicannon to the main Taverley Dungeon and cannon the baby blue dragons; adults give more profit. Skip Konar tasks to the Ogre Enclave, Catacombs or Ruins of Tapoyauik (no cannon or spread-out dragons); Vorkath after Dragon Slayer II is the most profitable alternative.
styleNotes: Susceptible to dragonbane weapons; adults need dragonfire protection, babies do not breathe fire; brutal blue dragons add magic and long-range dragonfire; Ruins of Tapoyauik dragons are weak to fire spells instead of water.
requiredItems: Anti-dragon shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield (except for baby dragons)

summary: Brine rats live only in the Brine Rat Cavern near Rellekka, entered by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree (fairy ring DKS is right beside it). They have low Defence but fairly high Attack and Strength, so bring food unless your Defence is around 70; two safespots exist behind the bones in the south-east and north-west corners. Rat bone weapons add 10 to your max hit against them. The cavern is single-way but a cannon can be used.
styleNotes: Low Defence, high Attack and Strength; rat bone weapons gain +10 max hit against them.
usefulItems: Rat bone weapon
Bones to Peaches tablets

summary: Catablepon are found only on the third level of the Stronghold of Security, the Pit of Pestilence, and are assigned by Mazchna. They cast Weaken with their glare, draining Strength until 8% plus 3 levels are gone, so Ranged or Magic from the safespots behind the tendrils or doors in the north-western room is advised over melee, or use Protect from Magic and restore potions. They are aggressive and use both melee and magic. The level is single-way but a cannon can be set up in the stronghold.
styleNotes: Their weakening glare drains Strength (Protect from Magic stops it), which makes melee training inefficient; no immunities are stated.
usefulItems: Strength potion or restore potion (if meleeing)
